body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose a 2-unit burst within weapon range. Compare this Action against each enemy in the burst. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and the enemy burns 1 die if it willingly leaves the burst before its next turn ends.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense granted by equipment or cover for this Action.
After this resolves, move up to 2 units without triggering Reactions caused by leaving cover or reach.

rider.title: SUPPRESSION
rider.html: If your Locked target is affected, increase the first die it burns because of this Action by 1.
